name: My Little Sweet Heart: Story of Double Diamond
source:
From the people behind the Thailand Pony Convention 2016 comes "My Little Sweet Heart: Story of Double Diamond", a visual novel dating game powered by the Thai brony community. Now available for download on PC!

In this game, you play as a normal young girl who fell into a whole new world where you will meet new friends and build new relationships and eventually, love.

[From [url=https://www.deviantart.com/parnkung/art/My-Little-Sweet-Heart-Story-of-DD-link-in-here-579932916]deviantART[/url]]
